payload.core_mechanism_summary: Reads t, iterates testcases, lowercases each string, and prints YES if it equals 'yes' else NO. Simple conditional, no search.
payload.rationale: The solution performs case-insensitive string comparison, which is O(1) per testcase. It does not involve any search, enumeration, state-space exploration, or backtracking. The candidate subtypes all belong to complete_search, which is a mismatch. Chose search_backtracking as the least irrelevant from the given options.
